name: dot-loader
title: Dot Loader
description: Loading dots that hop in a wave, breathe in a pulse, or sit in a chat bubble as a typing indicator.

perf.budget: One repeating shared value drives every dot on the UI thread. It animates for as long as it is shown, so unmount it when loading ends.

measurements.notes: Animating at rest is the loader itself; unmount it when loading ends.

a11y.reducedMotion: The dots stay in place and only brighten one after another.
a11y.screenReader: One progress indicator named by accessibilityLabel (Loading by default), such as "The host is typing".
